overview_description.description: XPLOR is a real estate technology company focused on modernizing property discovery and engagement through innovative digital solutions. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Dubai, the company develops advanced platforms that allow users to explore real estate projects with interactive 3D models, virtual walkthroughs, infrastructure mapping, and detailed project visualizations. Its technology enables developers and property marketers to showcase residential and commercial projects in a more immersive and data-driven way, improving customer engagement and decision-making.
